fallback_note: 10-K not yet filed at cutoff (D-Wave became public via SPAC Aug 5 2022); using the FY2022 Q3 10-Q as the most recent pre-cutoff filing.
extraction_note: This 10-Q is dominated by SPAC-business-combination mechanics, going-concern, warrants and Canadian SIF government-loan accounting. It contains NO disclosure of named Pentagon Program Elements, named DoD programs, named DoD customers, or quantified federal-program revenue. Customers are anonymized (Customer A/B/C). The phrase 'D-Wave Government Inc.' (the federal-contracting subsidiary named in the cohort metadata) does NOT appear in the filing. The strongest J-Book-grounded claim we can extract is the implicit one: D-Wave's only disclosed government revenue is Canadian SIF (a research-and-development grant program), not DoD. We extract the few revenue-concentration / customer / federal-presence claims that exist, plus control claims (patents, facilities, counterparty), and use the framework's verifiers to test whether D-Wave has ANY DoD presence at the cutoff date.
